title: Grateful Dead Live at Winterland Arena on 1970-04-15
source: Sony 770 7 Inch Half Track Reel Master @ 7.5 ips-(Bob Mathews); DAT x Zero (DL) > DAT x One (RE) > DAT x Two (JW); play back on a Sony PCM R-500-Digital Audio Labs Card deluxe-WAV @ 44.1KHz; Editing(Adobe Audition CC)-Mastering & Processing(iZotope Ozone 6)-FLAC encoding(dBpoweramp)-Tagging(Tag & Re-name) by Jim Wise

ai_review.summary: Stunning 1970 sound‑board capture of a hard‑rocking Winterland marathon, highlighted by a blistering Cryptical > The Other One suite and standout Candyman.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the crystal‑clear 1970 soundboard that preserves every jam with remarkable fidelity despite a few tape cuts. The performance is a one‑set powerhouse – a hard‑rocking ride from Cryptical Envelopment through an epic Other One, plus killer versions of Candyman, Man’s World and Dancing in the Streets. Overall the show is regarded as one of the season’s top outings.

ai_rating.rationale: Nearly all reviews are 5‑star, praising both the musical performance and the soundboard quality; only one review is mildly mixed (3½ stars) but still positive overall.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, clear 1970 soundboard with occasional tape cuts/patches; overall superb fidelity and balance.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A single, marathon set that flows seamlessly from Cryptical into an expansive Other One jam, with strong transitions and high‑energy rock throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly praised for his lead work – change‑ups, tight leads, and sweet drops back into Cryptical; highlighted as a driving force of the jams.
